object.attr: stakeholder: one registration per clone needs no arguments, because Claude Code sets the variable to the folder it was started in, as INSTALL.md describes; a rung-5 check confirms it. Made the default in 0.2.0. "Not empty" added for MELLON-MCP-SRS-7 (review Q33).
object.description: When started without `--repo-root` while the environment variable `CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR` is set and not empty, the MCP server shall take the folder that `CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR` names as the folder to serve.
